overview: The Deep is the largest subterranean region on Luclin, carved by Shissar tunnels, fungal growths, void fractures, and psychic predators. It is the gateway to Vex Thal.
history: The Shissar carved the earliest tunnels during their exile to Luclin.
Thought Horrors emerged from Shissar psychic experiments.
Bioluminescent fungal forests grew around arcane vents.
Void fractures opened after planar instability increased.
Vex Thal resonance currents began flowing through the deepest caverns.
regionHooks: A Thought Horror queen awakens and expands the hive.
Shrieker broods migrate toward the abyssal drop.
Shissar remnants attempt to reclaim ancient bio-labs.
A Vex Thal resonance surge destabilizes the caverns.
A new void fracture opens deeper than any previously recorded.
